name: @kira905/dsh-butler-install
description: Thin installer for the DSH butler suite: one command installs the plugin + CLI bundle through the host's own commands, then tells you whether it actually took effect, and can roll the whole batch back. Also ships a local wizard page (--ui) that lives outside DSH and can install from the browser: nothing runs until you press confirm; loopback only, per-process token + same-origin check, four POST entry points (preview/start/cancel/rollback), two honest rollbacks. It does not isolate you from other programs running as the same local user.
